upcoming.title: Scheduler inside the packaged app
upcoming.detail: Schedules save but never run in a released build today — the scheduler is not part of the bundle. Manage it from the Agent tray app until this lands.

upcoming.title: Signed macOS builds
upcoming.detail: No xattr step and no Gatekeeper workaround on the manual DMG. Homebrew already handles this; the direct download does not.

upcoming.title: Linux build
upcoming.detail: The backend already runs there. Packaging and the updater are what is missing.

labs.title: A local chat UI
